_readme: The launchd jobs THIS repo installs on a Mac. The declaration lives here, in the repo, because the 2026-09-14 failure was exactly a job whose definition lived OUTSIDE the repo: `com.divoom.monthlybest` was installed from `scripts/install_daemon.sh`, that script was deleted in 34045c0 (2026-08-30), the script it ran was moved to `examples/divoom_legacy/` in 6a4f91a (2026-09-14), and the job kept running against the empty path for 36 days — exit status 2, into a log nobody read. Nothing in CI could fail over a file the repo does not hold.
_shape: Each job: {label, program, arguments}. `program` and every entry of `arguments` are paths RELATIVE TO THE REPO ROOT, so the gate can check they exist on any machine, in CI, without knowing where the checkout lives. `label` is the launchd Label, and it is the job's identity: the gate matches installed agents by label, and an installed agent of this repo's that is NOT declared here is a finding.
_today: EMPTY, and that is the truth: this repo installs no launchd job. The one it did (`com.divoom.monthlybest`) was removed on 2026-10-20 — it ran reference-only Python that v0.38.0 retired, and the Rust implementation of the same work is a task inside the daemon, not a program a plist can point at. What is left of the capability is the app's own Auto-Sync, and whether the estate wants it back is `docs/ROADMAP.md` P7.3, the owner's call.
